tutorialPages.messageText: NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "8C9834924811F712A21473AF9893164C", "The Warehouse is your private storage for items, resources, and crates in each Settlement. To access your warehouse, speak to a Warehouse Vendor in a Settlement that is a Village or larger.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "350CDFB8402317035B708F8D1B86FC3F", "Items stored in your warehouse are only accessible from the Settlement they are stored in. You can see what you have stored in other Settlements, but you can\'t interact with them.")

NSLOCTEXT("[D20C99C24B2FABB4DC05E3BF1EE067C5]", "DAC64F1A48C58F7AB42B4081ECC81B87", "Additional storage space can be purchased through the warehouse vendor. The number of storage upgrades available will depend on the Settlement\'s size and your citizenship status.")
